per_question.question: What does Fusion 360 do?
per_question.answer:
Fusion 360 is a cloud-based software application that combines 3D CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB design capabilities [Source: Document 3]. It’s designed to accelerate the design process, from ideation to prototyping and manufacturing. Specifically, it’s used by industrial designers to speed up design, testing, fabrication, and collaboration with 3D prototyping [Source: Document 3, Document 4]. 

Here’s a breakdown of what it does, according to the documentation:

*   **3D CAD:** For creating complex product designs [Source: Document 1].
*   **CAM:** For optimizing shop-floor production with real-time insights [Source: Document 2].
*   **CAE:** For simulation and analysis [Source: Document 3].
*   **PCB Design:** For designing printed circuit boards [Source: Document 3].

You can find more details about the fundamentals of Fusion 360 in the “What is Autodesk Fusion?” course [Source: Web Result 7]. [Web: https://www.autodesk.com/solutions/what-is-fusion-360]

Additionally, you can find a general overview on Wikipedia [Source: Web Result 6]. [Web: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autodesk_Fusion]

per_question.question: Does AutoCAD LT do 3d?
per_question.answer:
AutoCAD LT is primarily a 2D CAD software designed for precision drafting and documentation. While it *can* open 3D models, it does not offer 3D viewing or navigation tools [Web: https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Is-it-possible-to-have-3D-view-in-AutoCAD-LT.html]. [Document 3] and [Document 5]

As a workaround, you can use preset 3D views [Web: https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Is-it-possible-to-have-3D-view-in-AutoCAD-LT.html] or convert 3D objects to 2D polylines within AutoCAD LT [Web: https://www.canadacad.ca/how-to-make-3d-in-autocad-lt/]. However, it’s important to note that AutoCAD LT is not designed for 3D modeling [Document 1] and [Document 2].

*   **UI Improvements:** Most actions are now moved into the context menu opened on right-click [Source: Document 4].
*   **Norway & Netherlands Terrain Updates:** Terrain fetching has been updated for Norway and the Netherlands [Source: Document 4].
